summary.prose: Building this Story turns src/shared/vibe-adapter.ts's placeholder read-only refusal into a live, qualified, and live-enforced authorization. Most of the work is one file: a new capability type and cache, a read-only argv branch with a stable cache key that survives the per-turn temp-dir churn, a standalone live-qualification probe suite with bounded retry and structural (never mutating) evidence, and the wiring that makes startTurn and readOnlySessionOnce actually use it. A failed live proof against the real binary is an accepted terminal outcome, not a blocking defect. One task is pure process: filing the HLD amendment this Story's own LLD already proposed but that was never tracked as a standalone artifact.

tasks.title: Add ReadOnlyCapability type and the stableDescriptorHash-keyed qualification cache
tasks.summary: Add the ReadOnlyCapability interface (status, allowedTools, reason?, provenAgainst: { stableDescriptorHash, effectiveConfigFingerprint } | undefined) to src/shared/vibe-adapter.ts, plus a module-level cache keyed by stableDescriptorHash. No behavior wiring yet -- this is the type/data-structure foundation the rest of the Story builds on.

tasks.title: Implement the live qualification suite
tasks.summary: Implement a standalone function that runs the bounded-retry allow-side probe (insrc_analyze / insrc_analyze_step reachable and completing), the immediate-fail deny/bypass probes using structural catalog evidence with the reconciled pass/fail polarity (a REQUIRED tool's exclusion/denial fails qualification; a DISALLOWED tool's exclusion/denial passes it; an actual bypass-absence failure -- a disallowed tool completing -- fails immediately, never retried), and export.json fingerprint extraction (readExitEvidence, reused in-module) with fail-closed behavior on a missing/unparsable export. Concurrent qualification requests for the same stable descriptor are coalesced into one in-flight probe run.
acceptanceChecks: The allow-side probe retries a bounded number of times on simulated connector-not-registered failures, then reports 'unavailable' with the reason if still unresolved
A structural catalog exclusion/denial of a disallowed tool PASSES qualification; exclusion/denial of a REQUIRED tool FAILS it
A genuine bypass-absence failure (a disallowed tool actually completes) fails qualification immediately with no retry
A missing or unparsable export.json fails qualification closed, never silently treated as passing
effectiveConfigFingerprint is extracted from a successful qualification probe's own export.json
Two concurrent calls that miss the cache for the identical stable descriptor share one in-flight qualification promise rather than running the probe suite twice

tasks.title: Wire startTurn's read-only dispatch and post-dispatch fingerprint invalidation
tasks.summary: Replace startTurn's mode:'read-only' placeholder throw (src/shared/vibe-adapter.ts:653-656) with: re-check the cache by stableDescriptorHash at dispatch time, dispatch via buildArgv's read-only branch (t2) when 'qualified', throw VibeReadOnlyUnavailableError with the recorded reason when 'unavailable'; after a qualified dispatch completes, compare its own export.json against the cached effectiveConfigFingerprint and invalidate the cache entry on a mismatch (the completed turn's own result is unaffected by the mismatch).
acceptanceChecks: A read-only request with a 'qualified' cached capability dispatches via buildArgv's read-only branch and returns the schema-validated result
A read-only request with an 'unavailable' cached capability throws VibeReadOnlyUnavailableError carrying the cached reason, without spawning a process

A qualified dispatch whose own export.json diverges from the cached effectiveConfigFingerprint invalidates the cache entry for the NEXT call, while the current call's own result is returned unaffected

epicImpact.findings: s1 built and landed sc1/sc2, matching their HLD interfaceSketches exactly, and left s2's own contract (sc3) as a pure placeholder refusal with no read-only buildArgv branch and no signal/deadline forwarding in readOnlySessionOnce. s2's work is genuinely greenfield within its own boundary (confirmed this round by direct re-read of the current file, not just the LLD's own claim); s1's BUILD was approved with a disclosed full-sweep gap (t7) and an unrelated documentation-only discrepancy, neither touching sc3. readExitEvidence (confirmed read this round) is the exact existing internal helper s2's qualification suite and post-dispatch fingerprint check reuse directly, in-module.
